	v1pb.UnimplementedInstanceServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAuthServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedUserServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedMemoServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAttachmentServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedAIServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedShortcutServiceServer
	v1pb.UnimplementedIdentityProviderServiceServer

	Secret                  string
	Profile                 *profile.Profile
	Store                   *store.Store
	MarkdownService         markdown.Service
	SSEHub                  *SSEHub
	NotificationEmailSender notification.EmailSender

	// thumbnailSemaphore limits concurrent thumbnail generation to prevent memory exhaustion
	thumbnailSemaphore       *semaphore.Weighted
	imageProcessingSemaphore *semaphore.Weighted

	// instanceStatsCache memoizes GetInstanceStats results for instanceStatsCacheTTL.
	instanceStatsCache instanceStatsCache
}

func NewAPIV1Service(secret string, profile *profile.Profile, store *store.Store) *APIV1Service {
	markdownService := markdown.NewService(
		markdown.WithTagExtension(),
		markdown.WithMentionExtension(),
	)
	return &APIV1Service{
		Secret:                   secret,
		Profile:                  profile,
		Store:                    store,
		MarkdownService:          markdownService,
		SSEHub:                   NewSSEHub(),
		NotificationEmailSender:  nil,
		thumbnailSemaphore:       semaphore.NewWeighted(3), // Limit to 3 concurrent thumbnail generations
		imageProcessingSemaphore: semaphore.NewWeighted(2),
	}
}

thinkingMessage.text:
The full picture is now clear.

Checking markdown tests and tag parser behavior to pin down exact extraction rules.

Enough information has been gathered to answer comprehensively.

MemoPayload stores five content-derived properties: HasLink, HasTaskList, HasCode, HasIncompleteTasks, and title. Tags are also content-derived. Location fields come from the API request and are not content-derived. The payload does not store location data.

Mentions are extracted by ExtractAll but ignored by RebuildMemoPayload. Snippet is computed at read time via GenerateSnippet. ExtractAll runs a single AST walk using GFM plus TagExtension and MentionExtension. Tags are drawn from TagNode and deduplicated while preserving case, excluding tags nested inside Link or Image ancestors. Mentions are drawn from MentionNode usernames, lowercased, deduplicated while preserving case, and excluded from the payload. Property values derive from the first block-level heading as title, presence of any Link node as HasLink, and presence of CodeBlock, FencedCodeBlock, or CodeSpan nodes as HasCode.

HasTaskList is set when any TaskCheckBox node is present. HasIncompleteTasks is set when any TaskCheckBox node is unchecked.

RebuildMemoPayload assigns Tags and Property from the extracted data. It leaves Location untouched and discards Mentions.

Three operations trigger recomputation. CreateMemo rebuilds on creation. UpdateMemo rebuilds when the update_mask includes "content". memopayload.RunOnce performs a batch rebuild, though it is not wired into server startup.

Location-only updates do not trigger recomputation.

Visibility, pinned state, timestamps, attachments, relations, and deletion do not trigger recomputation.

RunOnce is defined in server/runner/memopayload/runner.go but is not imported by server/server.go. No CLI or script references exist; it appears to be dead code.

ExtractAll is also invoked by resolveMentionTargets in memo_mention_helpers.go, used for mention notifications rather than payload storage.

APIV1Service enables both TagExtension and MentionExtension.

The payload is stored in the memo.payload JSON column. convertMemoFromStore exposes Tags, Property, and Location from that column. Snippet is computed separately at read time.

## Stored payload shape (`MemoPayload`)

From `proto/store/memo.proto` / `proto/gen/store/memo.pb.go`:

| Field | Type | Content-derived? |
|---|---|---|
| `property` | `MemoPayload.Property` | **Yes** (partially — see below) |
| `location` | `MemoPayload.Location` | **No** — set from API request |
| `tags` | `[]string` | **Yes** |

**`MemoPayload.Property`** (`proto/store/memo.proto:15-22`):

| Proto / JSON | Go field | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `has_link` / `hasLink` | `HasLink` | Any markdown link node |
| `has_task_list` / `hasTaskList` | `HasTaskList` | Any GFM task checkbox |
| `has_code` / `hasCode` | `HasCode` | Code block, fenced code block, or inline code span |
| `has_incomplete_tasks` / `hasIncompleteTasks` | `HasIncompleteTasks` | Any **unchecked** task checkbox |
| `title` | `Title` | Plain text of the **first block-level child** of the document, if it is an H1 |

**`MemoPayload.Location`** (`proto/store/memo.proto:24-28`) — **not** extracted from markdown:

| Field | Set from |
|---|---|
| `placeholder`, `latitude`, `longitude` | `request.Memo.Location` on create (`memo_service.go:111-113`) or update mask path `"location"` (`memo_service.go:481-484`) |

---

## What is computed but **not** stored in payload

**`ExtractAll` also returns `Mentions`** (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:20-25`, `379-381`), but **`RebuildMemoPayload` does not persist them** — only `Tags` and `Property` are written (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:85-86`). Mentions are used at notification time via `resolveMentionTargets` → `ExtractAll` (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32-35`).

**`Snippet`** is computed on read via `GenerateSnippet(content, 64)` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:83-85`), exposed on the API `Memo` message, **not** stored in `MemoPayload`.

---

## `ExtractAll` — extraction rules

Single goldmark parse with GFM + tag + mention extensions (configured in `v1.go:48-51`).

```355:421:internal/markdown/markdown.go
func (s *service) ExtractAll(content []byte) (*ExtractedData, error) {
	// ...
	// Tags: TagNode, excluding tags inside Link/Image ancestors (asMemoTagNode, lines 134-140)
	// Mentions: MentionNode.Username → strings.ToLower (lines 379-381)
	// Property.Title: first doc child if H1 (lines 383-388)
	// Property.HasLink: gast.KindLink (393-394)
	// Property.HasCode: CodeBlock | FencedCodeBlock | CodeSpan (396-397)
	// Property.HasTaskList / HasIncompleteTasks: east.KindTaskCheckBox (399-405)
	// Tags & Mentions deduplicated preserving case (417-419)
}
```

Tag exclusion inside links/images:

```122:140:internal/markdown/markdown.go
func isTagNodeInLinkOrImage(n gast.Node) bool { /* walks ancestors for Link/Image */ }
func asMemoTagNode(n gast.Node) (*mast.TagNode, bool) { /* rejects if inside link/image */ }
```

The standalone `ExtractProperties` / `ExtractTags` methods mirror the same property/tag logic in separate walks (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:142-241`).

---

## `RebuildMemoPayload` — what gets written

```74:87:server/runner/memopayload/runner.go
func RebuildMemoPayload(_ context.Context, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service) error {
	if memo.Payload == nil {
		memo.Payload = &storepb.MemoPayload{}
	}
	data, err := markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))
	// ...
	memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags
	memo.Payload.Property = data.Property   // full replacement
	return nil
}
```

- **`Location` is preserved** on content update (only `Tags`/`Property` overwritten; existing `memo.Payload` object is reused).
- On create, `RebuildMemoPayload` runs first, then location is applied from the request afterward (`memo_service.go:108-113`).

---

## Production triggers for recomputation

| Trigger | File:lines | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| **CreateMemo** | `memo_service.go:108-110` | Always, before `Store.CreateMemo` |
| **UpdateMemo** | `memo_service.go:436-451` | Only when `update_mask` includes `"content"` |
| **CreateMemoComment** | indirect via `CreateMemo` | `memo_service_comments.go:56-59` → same rebuild on comment create |
| **memopayload.RunOnce** | `runner.go:27-72` | Batch-rebuilds all memos — **not active in production startup** |

**Do not trigger rebuild:** update of `visibility`, `pinned`, `state`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `location`, `attachments`, `relations` alone.

**Mention side effects** (separate from payload): `dispatchMemoMentionNotificationsBestEffort` on create (`memo_service.go:171-173`), on content update (`memo_service.go:510-512`), and comment create (`memo_service_comments.go:123`).

---

## `RunOnce` runner — **not wired**

`memopayload.RunOnce` exists (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:26-72`) but **`server/server.go` only starts `s3presign` runner** (`server.go:153-174`). No import of `memopayload`, no `NewRunner` call, no CLI/script caller. It is a dormant batch-repair utility, not part of normal server lifecycle.

---

## All production callers of `ExtractAll` / `RebuildMemoPayload`

| Function | Callers (non-test) |
|---|---|
| `RebuildMemoPayload` | `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo` (content path), `memopayload.RunOnce` |
| `ExtractAll` | `RebuildMemoPayload`, `resolveMentionTargets` (`memo_mention_helpers.go:32`) |

`ExtractTags` / `ExtractProperties` / `RenameTag` have **no production callers** outside the markdown package itself.

---

## Downstream use of stored payload

- **API lists/previews:** `convertMemoFromStore` reads `Payload.Tags`, `Payload.Property`, `Payload.Location`; snippet is computed fresh (`memo_service_converter.go:47-51`, `76-80`).
- **CEL filters** query stored JSON: `tags`, `has_task_list`, `has_link`, `has_code`, `has_incomplete_tasks` → `memo.payload` column (`internal/filter/schema.go:173-229`).
- **User stats** count property flags from stored payload (`user_service_stats.go:141-151`, `257-267`).
